description: Attach uploaded files to a quiz. Omit a slot to leave it, send null to clear it. quiz: background (image or video, with dim 0.2-0.85), intro and outro (image or video, with seconds for an image, or trimStartSeconds, trimEndSeconds, audio "keep"|"mute" and volume for a video), soundEffects (enabled, correctAnswer, timerTick, countdownBeeps, transitions, each with a <name>Volume 0-1, and customAssets to use your own sound). questions[]: id with image, clip (a video played before the question, up to 60 seconds, which adds to the video length), background (or {"none": true} to turn the quiz background off). answers[]: id with image. Only asset ids from your own library are accepted.
name: quiz_video_update_quiz_media
title: Set a quiz's media
